topic: React Routing, Forms, and API Integration
learningObjectives: Create multi-page navigation using client-side routing concepts.
Build controlled forms and manage form submissions.
Connect React interfaces to backend APIs and display responses.

activities.title: Routing Architecture
activities.instruction: Map routes to their corresponding application views.

content.concept: Client-side routing maps application URLs to React components without requiring a full page reload.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Controlled Form Builder
activities.instruction: Build a form using React-controlled inputs.

content.concept: Controlled React inputs use component state as the source of truth for form values.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: API Integration Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of a React API request.

content.concept: Frontend API integration sends requests, handles responses, updates state, and renders the resulting data.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Response Handling Lab
activities.instruction: Select the correct UI behavior for each API response.

content.concept: A frontend should handle successful responses, loading states, validation failures, and server errors appropriately.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
